official_sources.name: HM Land Registry boundary agreements and determined boundaries PG40s4

direct_official_checks: the guide separately addresses boundary agreements and determined boundaries
determined boundaries are a specific application route
determined-boundary plan requirements are published separately
ordinary INSPIRE polygons do not establish determined-boundary status
ordinary title plans do not inherit determined-boundary precision
candidate precision is escalated only when the evidence route is explicitly determined boundary
precision-route provenance is retained with the candidate
quality_effect: Prevents determined-boundary tolerances being applied to ordinary title-plan or INSPIRE geometry.
